arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Dreeben argued the Sixth Amendment secures a fair trial through adversary procedures.
Mr. Fisher argued removing chosen counsel violates the Sixth Amendment immediately.
Justice Scalia asked when the Court first required the state to provide counsel.
Justice Stevens asked why the choice of counsel does not protect autonomy.
